info.title: Dab Automotive — Insha Backend APIs
info.description: Authentication, accounts, audit, settings, expenses and reporting. Test email delivery uses Ethereal. Teammate business tables are connected through the explicit view contracts in docs/TEAM_INTEGRATION.md.

amount.description: Positive PKR amount; send as text, with at most two decimal places.

value.description: Secret values are ******** or null. Other values retain their JSON type.

dashboard.description: Owner: financial and operational widgets. Administrator: these plus accounts, audit counts, configuration status and database health. Missing teammate sources are explicitly unavailable.

amount.description: Positive PKR amount; send as text, with at most two decimal places.

post.summary: Register a customer or request staff access
post.description: Public staff signup remains pending with customer privileges until reviewed.
Five wrong passwords lock an account for 15 minutes. Tokens expire in one hour.
Always returns 202 for eligible/unknown accounts. Delivery runs afterward. Codes expire in 10 minutes; 60-second cooldown; at most 3 issued per hour.

post.summary: Reset a password using an OTP
post.description: Single-use code, at most 5 wrong attempts; revokes existing tokens. A newer issued code invalidates the earlier one.
Owner or Administrator only; may create privileged roles. Does not bypass public signup restrictions.

put.description: Owner or Administrator. Revokes target tokens and OTPs. Use separate endpoints for role/status; password changes use OTP.
Owner or Administrator. Email sent after commit; response includes notification_sent.
Owner or Administrator. Self changes and deactivating the last active Owner are blocked. Invalidates tokens/OTPs.
Owner or Administrator. Self changes, pending/rejected accounts and last-active-Owner demotion are blocked. Invalidates tokens/OTPs.

get.description: Administrator only. No create/edit/delete API. UTC dates; stable newest-first order.
Administrator only. See docs/SETTINGS.md for all supported keys.

put.description: Administrator only. Known keys only. Secrets are encrypted with SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, never returned in full or included in audit details. null clears a secret or optional service URL.

get.description: Owner and Administrator read access; deleted entries excluded.

post.description: Owner only. Amount is a positive decimal string in PKR.

put.description: Owner only. At least one supported field required.

delete.description: Owner only. Audit history is retained.

get.description: Owner or Administrator. Read-only snapshot. Dates are UTC. Revenue/profit remain null and complete=false until BOTH teammate revenue views are connected. Receipts are counted once; refunds are negative receipts. This is a cash-received report, not an accrual or inventory-cost accounting report.

get.summary: Read Owner or Administrator dashboard data
get.description: Owner: financial and operational widgets. Administrator: adds account counts, audit counts, configuration status and database health. Complete=false if any required teammate view is missing. Bays are current state; jobs/orders/reviews use the selected UTC range.
